## Task 4 – The menu

**In the deck**, on the three slides of the hands-on. Call `try_spec()` three or four times, changing one argument at a time, and print the tries side by side with `my_experiments()`. Then submit the one that you would defend with `submit_exploration()`. Your dot is drawn on the [class chart](../../class-results.qmd) as an exploratory result.

[Open the deck at Task 4](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-2-the-menu){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-explore){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## Your placement

**In the deck**, in the cell of the placement slide. Rerun the specification that you submitted with `try_spec()`, read off your placement among the 864 specifications of the curve, hold it, and send it when the facilitator says go. Without a submission of your own, use the placement of the reproduced specification, 67%.

[Open the deck at your placement](../../live/short.html#/your-placement){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
